hypothesis: The same native learner can infer useful context-change boundaries from revealed consequences and recover causal knowledge during a continuous stream, without receiving the source regime or its change points.
source_schedule: 192 consecutive stream episodes per acquisition arm/seed. The source changes equation family/regime after counts48,96,144; phase length48. Learner sees only paired public views, its chosen first action, revealed next state, chosen second action and delayed terminal outcome. No source phase or boundary callback. Stream cohortckad23-stream uses global indices0..191 and source seed parent_seed+14000. Public begin_stream is called once at experiment start.
detector: Initialize exact scoreS=1 at native stream start, and begin the existing novel-context mixture (prior1/8 new candidate). Before each revealed episode compute its prequential joint likelihood p=P(S2 observed|view,X1)*P(Y observed|view,X1,S2,X2), including proper S2 conditional context weights. After updating from actual evidence set S=max(1,S/(4*p)). If S>=16 and at least8 witnessed episodes since current context_start, record its actual event ID, absolute evidence count and score, begin a new context from all retained evidence at current count, reset S=1. No witness is deleted and no global/native model state is reinitialized. Checkpoint persists stream_start and derives exact detections/state by chronological replay. Max1024 capacity; parent448 +192 =640.
acquisition: Three of every four active episodes use weighted hypothesis disagreement. Every fourth executes the learned two-stage plan. Random detector arm uses equal-budget deterministic SHA-uniform choices. Same exogenous source episode draws per arm. Other controls receive exact active receipts. All actions precede actual source feedback.
checkpoints: Score at stream counts0,16,32,...192 using96 separate held episodes at each point. Source family at count0 is phase0 and otherwise phase((count-1)//48). Held cohortckad23-held-{count} withindices0..95, same source seed offset14000. No held updates, including detector state. Held policies condition second decisions on revealed S2. Models receive no phase information.
controls: Independent exact consequence-likelihood monitor and same novel-context mixture; exact online probabilities, choices and inferred boundaries must tie.
Matched random acquisition with identical native detector.
Same native novel mixture started once, with no context detector resets, on identical active receipts.

metrics: Executed held policy reward, matched-action transition/terminal Brier, online acquired reward, detected boundaries/delays/false alarms, complete legacy/witness retention, full/cold continuation, wall/CPU/memory/checkpoint cost and exact parity. Matched strongest same-method exact control ties, so no scientific superiority claim.
